name: netpix-mobile
description: iOS/Android shell that wraps the web app build via Capacitor

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.ios:run: npm run sync && cap run ios
scripts.android:run: npm run sync && cap run android
